
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/codists/p/19269319" title="发布于 2025-11-25 17:27">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Pycharm错误：JetBrains AI  URL resolution failure</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="问题描述">问题描述</h1>
<h2 id="时间">时间</h2>
<p>2025/11/25</p>
<h2 id="pycharm-版本">Pycharm 版本</h2>
<p>2025.2.4</p>
<h2 id="问题">问题</h2>
<p>Pycharm AI Assistant 找不到输入框，提示：Error: 451 Exception during request to <a href="https://api.jetbrains.ai/ping" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://api.jetbrains.ai/ping</a> with code 451, id: Unknown。</p>
<p><img alt="20251125_JetBrains AI URL resolution failure" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2259714/202511/2259714-20251125172319925-2120780778.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1 id="原因分析">原因分析</h1>
<p>HTTP 451 状态码的意思是：Unavailable For Legal Reasons(因法律原因不可用)。</p>
<h1 id="解决方法">解决方法</h1>
<p>将 VPN 网络设置为 JetBrains AI Assistant 允许的地区(允许的地区名单详见：<a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/terms/jetbrains-ai/service-territory/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/terms/jetbrains-ai/service-territory/</a>)，如：美国。经验证，可行：</p>
<p><img alt="20251125_Pycharm AI Assistant" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2259714/202511/2259714-20251125172328332-1617656336.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1 id="总结">总结</h1>
<p>刚开始只是以为哪里设置错了，没想到是 JetBrain 主动设置的。只是切换 VPN 的网络来解决，实际上并不方便，因为切换到某些地区的网络可能网速比较慢，倒不如考虑其它AI(如：国外的cursor,chatgpt 等，国内的deepseek, 豆包等)。</p>
<p><img alt="codist_mp" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2259714/202508/2259714-20250820144002045-241589284.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>欢迎搜索及关注：编程人(a_codists)</p>
